mapper.select: SELECT NVL(total_discharge_count, 0) AS totalDischargeCount, NVL(total_discharge_compare, 0) AS totalDischargeCompare, NVL(discharged_count, 0) AS dischargedCount, NVL(discharged_compare, 0) AS dischargedCompare, NVL(not_discharged_count, 0) AS notDischargedCount, NVL(not_discharged_compare, 0) AS notDischargedCompare, NVL(settlement_amount, 0) AS settlementAmount, NVL(settlement_amount_compare, 0) AS settlementAmountCompare FROM TR_DISCH_SETTLE_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT item_date AS itemDate, NVL(total_last, 0) AS totalLast, NVL(total_current, 0) AS totalCurrent, NVL(total_compare, 0) AS totalCompare, NVL(discharged_last, 0) AS dischargedLast, NVL(discharged_current, 0) AS dischargedCurrent, NVL(discharged_compare, 0) AS dischargedCompare, NVL(not_discharged_last, 0) AS notDischargedLast, NVL(not_discharged_current, 0) AS notDischargedCurrent, NVL(not_discharged_compare, 0) AS notDischargedCompare, NVL(amount_last, 0) AS amountLast, NVL(amount_current, 0) AS amountCurrent, NVL(amount_compare, 0) AS amountCompare FROM TR_DISCH_SETTLE_DTL WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY item_date
